items.title: Add capability contract inputs to DONE version bump predicate
items.context: Extend the DONE merge changed-path predicate so docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/** trigger the same patch-version/build path as packages/main/src/**, without including all docs or experiments.
items.userSees: A DONE story that changes docs/CLI.md or packages/main/tests capability proof files triggers the CLI patch version bump instead of printing the skip line.

happy.desc: A docs/CLI.md-only changed-path set returns true for the DONE version bump predicate.

edge.desc: A packages/main/tests regression changed-path set returns true for the DONE version bump predicate.

adversarial.desc: Unrelated docs/requirements and experiments/** paths still return false and do not trigger a CLI version bump.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed and asserts docs/CLI.md changed-path sets return true for the DONE version bump predicate.
Smoke passed and asserts packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs returns true for the DONE version bump predicate.
Smoke passed and asserts docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md, arbitrary docs, and experiments/tier-c-proof/sum.mjs remain non-bump inputs.

items.title: Update smoke coverage and lifecycle docs for the new bounded policy
items.context: Update version-bump smoke assertions and story-lifecycle documentation to describe watched CLI runtime plus capability contract/proof inputs.
items.userSees: Developers can see exactly why B-3a4d-like stories now bump while general docs and experiments still do not.

happy.desc: version-bump-smoke passes with assertions for docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/** bumping.

edge.desc: story-lifecycle docs name the bounded capability contract/proof input class.

adversarial.desc: The docs and smoke still prove experiments/** and arbitrary requirements docs are outside the automatic CLI bump policy.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed: version-bump smoke reported 74 assertions, including docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/** positive assertions plus unrelated docs/experiments negative assertions.
